instruction: On slide 2, underline the title and type 'Team Members' in the text content area below it.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to slide 2, opened View > Notes to add 'Team Members' as a note, then selected the title text and applied bold formatting. Completed in 15 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress slides, use View menu to access Notes view, type text in notes area, select title text, and apply font formatting (bold). Familiar with text selection and formatting toolbar.
metadata.task_rationale: Original task added note text matching the title and applied bold. This variation tests underline formatting (related to bold) and typing in the body/subtitle placeholder instead of the notes area — same interaction pattern but different targets.
metadata.explanation: Task requires underlining the slide 2 title and typing 'Team Members' in the body text placeholder. Getter extracts title underline property and body text. Metric awards 0.5 for underline, 0.5 for correct body text (case-insensitive contains match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly accesses slide 2 (index 1) and extracts title placeholder (idx=0) underline property via run.font.underline and body placeholder (idx=1) text content.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('expected_underline') and expected.get('expected_body_text') without wrapping in 'rules' key.
Both instruction requirements (underline title + type 'Team Members' in body area) are fully covered with sensible 0.5/0.5 partial credit.
Postconfig correctly saves the file with Ctrl+S before getter reads it, ensuring state is persisted to disk.
Body text comparison uses case-insensitive contains match, which is appropriately flexible.

Minor limitation: only the first non-empty run's underline is checked. If the title has multiple runs with mixed underline states, this may not fully verify 'underline the title'. However, this is a reasonable heuristic for typical usage.
